description: This file defines domain models for requests and responses in an e-commerce chatbot backend, using Pydantic for data validation and serialization.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a chat message with role and content.

classes.name: ChatRequest
classes.description: Model for initiating a chat, including session ID, messages, and context.

classes.name: ChatResponse
classes.description: Model for the chatbot's reply, including session ID, reply message, and metadata.

classes.name: QARequest
classes.description: Model for user questions about products or policies.

classes.name: QAResponse
classes.description: Model for answering user questions, including related products and confidence score.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a product with details like ID, title, description, price, and optional image.

classes.name: ProductSearchRequest
classes.description: Model for searching products with query, limit, and filters.

classes.name: ProductSearchResponse
classes.description: Model for returning matched products and total count.

classes.name: RecommendRequest
classes.description: Model for generating product recommendations based on user or recent views.

classes.name: RecommendResponse
classes.description: Model for recommended products with rationale.

classes.name: CreateSessionRequest
classes.description: Model for initializing a chat session with optional context.

classes.name: SessionInfo
classes.description: Stores session ID, creation timestamp, and context.
